profile_text.body:
OpenAI, founded in 2015 and based in San Francisco, California, describes ChatGPT as a tool to "answer questions, write, create images, complete work, and code—all in one place." The company operates ChatGPT as a free and paid service, available via web and app. OpenAI notes that chats may be reviewed and used to improve its AI models.

OpenAI's product portfolio includes ChatGPT (general LLM assistant), the OpenAI API and GPT models (direct API with usage-based pricing), the OpenAI Playground and Dashboard (API testing, fine-tuning, and team management), DALL-E (image generation), Sora (video generation), Whisper API (speech recognition and transcription), and Operator (autonomous web agent). The company's products span chat, coding, image and video generation, and voice interfaces.

OpenAI faces significant litigation. Cases are pending in federal courts across multiple districts, including Gourley v. OPENAI FOUNDATION (N.D. Florida), Starr v. OpenAI Group PBC (N.D. California), wikiHow, Inc. v. OpenAI, Inc. (S.D. New York), Haugland v. OpenAI, Inc. (D. Hawaii), X.AI Corp., et al. v. OpenAI, Inc., et al. (Ninth Circuit), Office of the Attorney General, State of Florida, Department of Legal Affairs v. OpenAI Global, LLC (S.D. Florida), Craddock v. OpenAi OpCo LLC (N.D. California), Byrd v. OpenAI, Inc. (N.D. California), Couture v. Openai Global, LLC (S.D. California), and Mall v. OPENAI FOUNDATION (N.D. Florida), plus cases in E.D. Arkansas. California accounts for 208 litigation matters involving OpenAI. Multiple MCP servers integrate OpenAI's tools for orchestration, authentication, and structured outputs.
